title: How Kelley Liu Is Building Song of Skin Into an $8.5 Million K-beauty Retail Business
summary: The founder is opening Song of Skin’s first permanent store in SoHo, hosting a two-weekend L.A. pop-up and growing her CelDot skin care brand.
